answers.how: A quadratic fit to the car's motion gives approximately 130 px/s², so the scale is 13 px/m. Near 0.5 s, the plane moves about 786 px/s; dividing by the scale gives its speed.
The car is approximately 76 px long. The acceleration-derived scale is 13 px/m, giving 76/13 meters.
The car is approximately 24 px high, including its wheels. Using 13 px/m gives 24/13 meters.
The fully visible plane is approximately 491 px long. Using the acceleration-derived scale of 13 px/m gives its length.
The plane spans approximately 146 px vertically. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 13 px/m gives its height.
